name: Shibusawa Logistics Corporation
summary: Shibusawa Logistics Corporation provides logistics and warehousing services in Japan and internationally. The company provides strategic logistics services, such as warehousing and distribution processing for various types of cargo; truck transportation services, including transportation, and ocean freight container transportation for customer's logistics; ocean and air import and export handling services comprising customs clearance, overland transport, and warehouse storage at departure and arrival ports and airports; document storage and trunk room storage; and moving &household goods storage.
